title: Music City Studio A,  Music Row,  Nashville, TN
description:
In the heart of Music City, this quaint unit is the perfect spot to experience all Nashville has to offer. Located within walking distance to some of Nashville's hottest music joints, restaurants and bars. Historic RCA Studios, ASCAP just to name a few.  If walking is not your thing, grab a bike or Uber.  Broadway is 1-4 miles depending on destination 
Unit A completely remodeled in August 2024.
Part of a triplex, so perfect for groups traveling together who also want some private space.

The space
Address of unit: 1021 17th Ave. South. Nashville, TN 37212.  UnitA
This unit is 2-bedroom 2 bath with a pullout sleeper sofa.  Nice living area with eat in kitchen. All new stainless-steel appliances.  Firepit on deck for outside enjoyment.
Parking in front on first come, first served basis or make the block and travel down alley to our private parking behind unit
Not a hotel. Housekeeping not provided.  8 white towels , rags, black rags for make up.  Full roll Toilet Paper in each bathroom, paper towels, dishwasher pod, Tide pod, travel-sizes shampoo/conditioner. Extra you will need to grab.

Guest access
Entire unit is yours to enjoy.

Other things to note
Minimum Age to rent: 25  
Check in at 3pm and check out at 10am are established to give cleaners time to get in and out for next guest.  Please Plan your trips accordingly.  
NOTE: STARTER SUPPLIES provided:  1 roll of toilet paper per bathroom, hand soap, dishwasher pod, a tide pod for load of laundry, coffee for your first morning, sweetener.
Security Deposit will be KEPT if the white rags or towels are used for removal of MAKE-UP.  
 use the BLACK make up rags for this purpose. thank you!
NO EARLY CHECK -INS/Late check outs or luggage drop offs . PLEASE PLAN ACCORDINGLY.
I have to block off calendar to allow cleaners time to get unit ready. 
Thanks in advance for understanding.
